nodes.description: Mycobacterium leprae depends on DNA-dependent RNA polymerase for transcription. nodes.description: In lepromatous leprosy the bacilli multiply inside dermal macrophages that cannot kill them. The macrophages fill with bacilli, giving the foamy (Virchow, lepra) cells that are diffusely distributed through the dermis, and the bacteriological index on slit-skin smear is high. This bacillary load is what drives the diffuse tissue infiltration of the lepromatous pole and the immune-complex reactions of erythema nodosum leprosum.
